d:
Aur mere chatoro, kaise ho aap, Andhra Pradesh me shaadi me, functions me, caterer log Bhindi Fry banate hai jo ki rice ke saath kaafi achi lagti hai, isko bendakaya fry bhi bolte hai, ye super crispy aur kurkuri hoti hai, aur inko starter jaise, ya chakhna jaise khane me bhi bahut maja aata hai. Agar aapko crispy snacks pasand hai to ye bahut acha lagaega, aur pata bhi nai chalega ki bhindi kha rahe hai. Perfect for bhindi haters!
Ingredients:
Bhindi - 250g
Lemon juice - 1/2
Besan - 4 tbsp
Rice flour - 1 tbsp
Paani - sprinkle ke liye
Peanuts - 1/4 cup
